Update: Nov 6th, 2026 06:01 EST 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google Gio Reyna is expected to be back in action today as Strasbourg travel to face Toulouse in France’s Ligue 1.
 The American midfielder has been finding his feet in the French top flight, contributing two goals so far this season. His team heads into the latest game on the back of thrashing Auxerre 5-1 last weekend. Reyna was in the starting XI, being substituted with just over 20 minutes left for Diogo Sousa. All signs point to him getting the nod again.
 5️⃣ Goals
1️⃣ Picture #RCSAAJA pic.twitter.com/reAbscwoe1 
— Racing Club de Strasbourg Alsace English (@RCSA_English) November 1, 2026 
 What time is Toulouse vs Strasbourg?
 The game kicks off at 2:45 p.m. ET (11:45 a.m. PT) on Friday, November 6, at the Stadium de Toulouse.
 Strasbourg go into matchday 10 in 13th position really hoping to build some momentum following an inconsistent start to the campaign. Toulouse sit one place above, only on goal difference.
 Giovanni Reyna was struggling for minutes when Mauricio Pochettino called him up for the World Cup.
Today, he’s starting at Strasbourg and looks set for a pivotal role for the USMNT this month.
I asked Pochettino about Reyna in yesterday’s presser: https://t.co/nuizkiLSe5 pic.twitter.com/0stCXP2lN2 
— Zach Lowy (@ZachLowy) November 5, 2026 
 How can you watch Gio Reyna play in the US?
 American viewers can follow Toulouse vs Strasbourg through beIN SPORTS , with coverage listed on beIN SPORTS 3 and beIN SPORTS en Español .
 The game will also be available to stream through Fubo , which offers access to beIN’s Ligue 1 coverage. We’ll also have live text coverage from kick off.
 For USMNT fans keeping tabs on Reyna’s European adventure – with him already named in Pochettino’s latest roster – it’s another opportunity to see how the 23-year-old is progressing.
